_what: Where keep-copies-in-step reads and keeps the person's own rows. Every name here is a record kind or id the rows in tool-rows.json are granted. The rules (how often a device row is written again, how many are read, the words of each version) are read-data/catch-up.json, moved with the code.

devices._why: The person's device rows ({ device_id, title, kind, state, waiting, at, seen_at, copy? }), newest first. Stored as a setting, whose value holds the list under `value`.

kept_apart._why: The versions two copies changed apart are records of the type read-data/catch-up.mjs names KEPT_APART, one per contested record, each { "<field or *>|<checksum>": { record, record_type, field, value } }.
